title: Testing: a first-class language concern
preamble:
# Testing: a first-class language concern

The language-level testing contract — the primitives every DS runtime must
provide, the affordances rule authors must have, and the
conformance surface the spec itself defines.

Implementation choices (specific APIs, test-file formats, how
the reference runtime wires it all up) live in
[RTIM]; this doc is the
contract they must honour.

## What this is not

- Not a test-framework API. The language specifies what
  primitives must exist; the runtime documents the concrete
  surface.
- Not the test-file syntax. That is
  [LTSL], built on the
  primitives this doc establishes.
- Not a CI / build-integration story. How tests execute under
  `make` / `ctest` / `bazel` is a runtime concern.
